comments.author: ximinez
comments.body:
Nit: [We've defined "chore" as "not affecting the binary"](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#good-commit-messages), so please don't use that prefix in the merge commit. And maybe change the PR name.

The "Trivial" label is accurate, though.

comments.author: mvadari
comments.body:
> Nit: [We've defined "chore" as "not affecting the binary"](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md?rgh-link-date=2025-09-26T17%3A56%3A17Z#good-commit-messages), so please don't use that prefix in the merge commit. And maybe change the PR name.
> 
> The "Trivial" label is accurate, though.

@ximinez sorry, didn't realize there was an official definition of "chore". I've updated the title. The commit doesn't use that name.

comments.author: intelliot
comments.body:
By our definitions, I'd set the "Type of Change" to either:
-  New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- Release

The small size of the change (1 line or 3 characters) is not relevant to the Type of Change. Agree with @ximinez that this is definitely not a Chore
